test_title: PYST 119: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 17 Jan, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: Six students are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. A sits to the immediate left of C. E sits third to the right of D. D is an immediate neighbour of C. B is an immediate neighbour of both E and F. Who sits second to the left of A?
solution:
As per the given information, the seating arrangement is as follows:

1. A is sitting to the immediate left of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/90d818593b2e42581a3156dd0576026d1cd7498d8a6a1958d283ffc396726210.png] 

2. D is an immediate neighbour of C. E is sitting third to the right of D.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/208cc0aaeaced8711e2fc893f525b8a45aae057b9e966f3448c31db688cef957.png] 

3. B is an immediate neighbor of both E and F.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/16d0b61ed6a4db709935439849d2b0084784fba5062f4f37b9f2f56cf3237e42.png] 

Here, B is sitting second to the left of A.

Hence the correct answer is "B".
